**Paris Get‑away: 7‑Day Itinerary (Mid‑Season, 2026)**  
*(Assumes you’re flying into Charles de Gaulle Airport and staying in a boutique hotel in the 7th arrondissement – close to the Eiffel Tower, Louvre, and Seine.)*

| Day | Morning | Afternoon | Evening |
|-----|---------|-----------|---------|
| **1** | Arrive, transfer to hotel, check‑in. | Light stroll along the Seine, visit the **Pont Alexandre III** and **Tuileries Garden**. | Dinner at **Le Coupe Chou** (classic French bistro). |
| **2** | Breakfast at **Café de Flore** (Saint‑Germain‑des‑Pres). | Louvre Museum (reserve tickets online; focus on the Mona Lisa, Venus de Milo, and Egyptian Antiquities). | Sunset cruise on the Seine (Bateaux Mouches). |
| **3** | Visit **Eiffel Tower** (book skip‑the‑line tickets). | Picnic at Champ de Mars, then walk to **Arc de Triomphe** and Champs‑Élysées. | Show at **Moulin Rouge** or a jazz club in Montmartre. |
| **4** | Day trip to **Versailles** (train RER C). Explore the palace, gardens, and Trianon. | Return to Paris, relax at your hotel. | Light dinner near the hotel; try **Crêperie Bretonne**. |
| **5** | Explore **Montmartre**: Sacré‑Coeur, Place du Tertre, and the artists’ square. | Visit **Musée d’Orsay** (Impressionist masterpieces). | Dinner at **Le Relais de l’Entrecôte** (famous steak‑and‑french fries). |
| **6** | Day trip to **Giverny** (Claude Monet’s house & gardens). | Return to Paris, free time for shopping on Rue Saint‑Honoré. | Attend a performance at the **Opéra Garnier** (check schedule). |
| **7** | Brunch at **Ladurée** on Champs‑Élysées. | Last‑minute souvenir shopping, visit **Centre Pompidou** for modern art. | Farewell dinner at **Le Jules Verne** (Eiffel Tower restaurant) or a cozy bistro in Le Marais. |
| **8** | Check‑out, transfer to airport. |  |  |

### Practical Tips

| Topic | Recommendation |
|-------|----------------|
| **Transportation** | Purchase a **Paris Visite** pass (valid for 2–5 days) covering metro, buses, and RER within zones 1–3. For day trips, buy a single‑journey ticket or use the **Navigo Week Pass** if staying longer. |
| **Accommodation** | Boutique hotel in 7th arrondissement (e.g., Hôtel Le Six, Hotel Le Meurice). Book early for best rates. |
| **Dining** | Reserve tables at popular restaurants (especially for dinner shows). Try local specialties: croissants, escargot, coq au vin, macarons. |
| **Tickets** | Book major attractions (Louvre, Eiffel Tower, Versailles, Musée d’Orsay) online in advance to avoid queues. |
| **Weather** | Mid‑season (May–June): average 18–22 °C. Pack light layers, comfortable walking shoes, umbrella. |
| **Language** | Basic French phrases help; most staff speak English. |
| **Safety** | Keep valuables secure, especially in tourist hotspots. |

### Suggested Budget (per person)

| Item | Cost (EUR) |
|------|------------|
| Flights (round‑trip from US) | 600–900 |
| Accommodation (7 nights) | 1,200–1,800 |
| Food & drinks | 400–600 |
| Attractions & tours | 250–350 |
| Transportation (metro, day trips) | 100–150 |
| Miscellaneous (souvenirs, tips) | 150–200 |
| **Total** | **2,700–3,800** |

Feel free to tweak the itinerary based on your interests—whether you prefer museums, food, or day trips. Bon voyage!
